title: D7: jmap-chat is Agora's chat format (decided)
description: DECIDED (Mark 2026-10-16), option A: Agora retires its duplicate chat types (TextBody, reactions, pins, edits as Agora-defined objects); a chat message on Agora is a draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 Message carried in the typed envelope. Agora keeps only protocol-plumbing types without jmap equivalents (SpaceStateHead, SpeakRequest, access-key announcements, compliance records, call signaling, etc.).
close_reason: Decided by Mark 2026-10-16 and applied in spec (13, 05, 06, 11, 14, profiles of jmap family)
